abort.already_configured: Eshtaya Smart Control is already configured.

init.title: Startup safety & legacy migration
init.description: Control the v2.4 startup barrier and optional migration from retired Eshtaya integrations. Native Home Assistant Group discovery/takeover is independent and remains available.

data.startup_wait_referenced_integrations: Wait for integrations that own referenced Multi-Way entities
data.startup_settle_seconds: Quiet settle window after providers are ready (seconds)
data.repair_missing_confirmations: Missing checks required before creating a Repair issue
data.legacy_hacs_cleanup: Remove verified legacy HACS repositories after migration

data_description.startup_wait_home_assistant: Recommended. Multi-Way stays protected until Home Assistant fires its startup-complete event.
data_description.startup_wait_referenced_integrations: Recommended. If a referenced entity has a registered owner that is still loading/retrying, Eshtaya waits instead of declaring it missing.
data_description.startup_settle_seconds: Additional stable period after referenced providers stop loading. Default: 15 seconds.
data_description.startup_max_wait_seconds: Bounded safety timeout so a broken provider can never block Eshtaya forever. Default: 240 seconds.
data_description.repair_grace_seconds: A missing entity must remain absent after the startup barrier for this long before it can mature into a Repair issue. Default: 90 seconds.
data_description.repair_missing_confirmations: After the grace period, the absence must be observed repeatedly. Default: 3 checks.
data_description.legacy_migration_enabled: Off by default in v2.4. Turn this on only when you intentionally need to migrate a retired Eshtaya integration. An already in-progress safe cutover is allowed to finish automatically.
data_description.migrate_legacy_entity_manager: Only applies when legacy migration is enabled.
data_description.migrate_legacy_multiway: Only applies when legacy migration is enabled.
data_description.migrate_legacy_template_manager: Only applies when legacy migration is enabled.
data_description.legacy_hacs_cleanup: Off by default. Cleanup happens only after successful validation and only when this option is enabled.
data_description.legacy_service_aliases: Off by default. Enable only if old automations still call eshtaya_multiway or eshtaya_template_manager services.

missing_output.title: Multi-way output entity is missing
missing_output.description: The output entity {entity} used by group {group} is still missing after Home Assistant startup protection and the configured repair grace/confirmation checks. Open Multi-Way Control and replace the output entity or restore the original entity.

missing_controller.title: Multi-way controller entity is missing
missing_controller.description: The controller entity {entity} used by group {group} is still missing after Home Assistant startup protection and the configured repair grace/confirmation checks. Open Multi-Way Control and replace or remove that controller.

output_unresponsive.title: Multi-way output is not confirming commands
output_unresponsive.description: The physical output {entity} in group {group} has repeatedly failed to confirm commands. Check the device/integration connection, then use Sync Now after it is healthy.
